paragraphs.text: Dionus is a legendary elf druid from Dominaria .
My people are like the great magnigoth trees. We’ve seen ice, flood, invasions, and wars, yet our roots remain strong.

Dionus is a character who was originally mentioned in Magic 2010 and a few other core sets before later debuted as his card in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Green Elves deck . He is a dominarian elvish archdruid likely from Yavimaya . Dionus was originally thought to be a Shandalarian character, as he is quoted across Magic 2010 and Magic 2014 flavor texts, including a card depicting a Shandalarian sliver . His card in Foundations Jumpstart , however, explicitly mentions magnigoth trees, native to Dominaria, as well as referencing the Ice Age , Flood Ages , and Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .
